validation: Existing five validation scenes and labels unchanged; select checkpoint on the pre-existing objective only. No new test predictions before candidate and policy hashes are sealed.
annotation_method: Individually viewed native PDS exposures, manually traced 512-preview coordinates scaled to native 1024. Explicit ground ROIs, rock silhouettes and self-hardware; uncertain pixels 255, uncertain boundary collar. Not independent expert or metric-height ground truth.
selection_objective: 0.5 obstacle IoU +0.3 obstacle recall +0.2 hardware IoU -2 hardware-as-obstacle -0.5 ground-as-obstacle
notes: 4226 and4725 are strongly underexposed; ambiguous ground/rocks stay unknown. Retain identifiable hardware; do not infer hazards hidden in darkness.
4183 and4280 add extra heldout episodes before any prediction, to increase physical-object population beyond the prior seven-object benchmark.
New test episodes must pass hash, RMC site/drive and +/-6-sol cross-split checks before training. Old consumed tests are explicitly training now, never fresh evaluation.
